mapper.select: select latest_audit.staff_id_in_app as umWxid, latest_audit.contact_im_id_in_app as recId, device_mapping.wx_phone as umPhone from ( select current_audit.* from ( select friend_phone, staff_id_in_app, max(`timestamp`) as latest_timestamp from mmba_wx_friend_change_audit where behavior_type = 60 and um = #{um} and friend_phone = #{friendPhone} group by friend_phone, staff_id_in_app ) latest join mmba_wx_friend_change_audit current_audit on current_audit.friend_phone = latest.friend_phone and current_audit.staff_id_in_app = latest.staff_id_in_app and current_audit.`timestamp` = latest.latest_timestamp where current_audit.behavior_type = 60 and current_audit.um = #{um} and current_audit.is_friend = '1' and current_audit.contact_im_id_in_app is not null and current_audit.contact_im_id_in_app != '' ) latest_audit join mmba_device_mapping device_mapping on device_mapping.um = latest_audit.um and device_mapping.wxid = latest_audit.staff_id_in_app where device_mapping.mapping_status = 'ACTIVE' and device_mapping.wx_phone is not null and device_mapping.wx_phone != '' order by latest_audit.`timestamp` desc, latest_audit.es_id desc limit 1

select * from mmba_wx_account_audit where 1 = 1
and um = #{request.um}
and device_id = #{request.deviceId}
and (imei = #{request.imei} or imei2 = #{request.imei})
and staff_name like concat('%', #{request.staffName}, '%')
and staff_id_in_app like concat('%', #{request.staffIdInApp}, '%')
and staff_im_app_account like concat('%', #{request.staffImAppAccount}, '%')
and ( staff_name like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or staff_id_in_app like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or staff_im_app_account like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or staff_im_nick_name like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or staff_mobile like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') )
order by timestamp desc, create_time desc, es_id desc

select * from mmba_wx_friend_list_audit where 1 = 1
and um = #{request.um}
and (imei = #{request.imei} or imei2 = #{request.imei})
and staff_name like concat('%', #{request.staffName}, '%')
and staff_id_in_app like concat('%', #{request.staffIdInApp}, '%')
and contact_mobile like concat('%', #{request.contactMobile}, '%')
and ( contact_im_app_nick_name like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or contact_im_app_account like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or contact_mobile like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') or staff_name like concat('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') )
order by timestamp desc, create_time desc, es_id desc
